States and behavior

Menu-bar mode, dropdown, delayed pointer submenu, unavailable item that still takes the highlight, check mark, exclusive radio mark and numbered inline MRU group.

Keyboard

Alt alone or F10 focuses the bar; Alt+F/V opens a menu. Arrows navigate; Enter/Space activates, and on an unavailable command closes the menu and runs nothing; underlined letters select. Escape closes one layer at a time, then exits the bar and restores focus. Tab leaves.

Scope and adaptation

The 1995 draft describes staged menu dismissal and sparse cascades. Short inline MRUs above a separated final Exit match period examples; long/grouped histories may use a submenu. ARIA is an explicit browser choice; the 400 ms pointer delay is the one measured on Windows 95. A menu opened with the mouse has no command highlighted until an arrow key or the pointer chooses one. Ctrl+N is illustrative menu text, not a registered browser shortcut.
